guard: on a user mesh a role:<r> scope token is delegation authority only and mints no task-queue row for the agent itself
why: The agent mint grants task-queue rows for each role:<r> token in its capabilities, so a static spawner's evidence shows the roles it may hand on. A user mesh passes its ledger scope as those capabilities, and there the token only lets the ledger walk hand the role on. U1 passes the scope through unfiltered, so a user-mesh agent would bind every role its scope names.
views.smoke.ts imports the callout supplier by relative source path, so the mutated file is the file that runs and there is no build in the command.

mutations.name: U1 mint the user mesh's role tokens
mutations.expectRed: a role:<r> scope token mints no task-queue row for that role on a user mesh
